run_clm_finetune: run causal language model fine-tuning on a HuggingFace dataset or text file with block_size and training parameters
run_clm_from_scratch: run causal language model training from scratch using a model type and config overrides without a pretrained checkpoint
run_clm_streaming_dataset: run causal language model fine-tuning with streaming dataset mode for large datasets that do not fit in memory
run_clm_split_dataset: run causal language model fine-tuning with automatic train validation split percentage on a dataset without a validation split
run_clm_group_texts: run causal language model fine-tuning with custom block_size to group tokenized texts into chunks of specified length
